aboutText: AJ Building & Restoration has been restoring properties in Sunshine North and across Melbourne for over 40 years. Specialising in emergency make-safe services, water damage restoration, fire and smoke damage restoration, roof restoration, mould remediation and general home repairs, our experienced team delivers fast, reliable results when it matters most. We are fully licensed, insured and work closely with insurance companies to make the claims process seamless. Call today for a free quote from Sunshine North's trusted restoration specialists.
